Write the fishery outputs

Source: R/io.R
om_write_fishery.Rd

Saves the fishery truth, the scenario data sets, the diagnostic tables and the figures with the files and names of Experimento 02 (outputs/truth/, outputs/datasets/, outputs/diagnostics/, outputs/figures/ inside dir).

Usage

om_write_fishery(
  fishery,
  scenarios = NULL,
  dir,
  label = fishery$cfg$general$label,
  csv = fishery$cfg$output$save_csv,
  diagnostics = TRUE,
  figures = fishery$cfg$output$save_figures,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

fishery

An om_fishery object.

scenarios

An om_scenarios object (or NULL).

dir

Folder playing the role of Simulacao_Pesca/.

label

Label of the files (default cfg$general$label).

csv

Also write .csv.gz copies of the large tables.

diagnostics, figures

Write diagnostic tables / figures.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisible character vector of written files.
